blends.name: New CrAIzy Eggs Box
blends.desc:
Blend 20 of any Crazy Eggs NFTs to get a pack featuring a mint-on-demand NEW CrAIzy Egg!  

WARNNG: ANY NFTs from the collection can be selected, so we recommend NOT using the auto-select.  Otherwise you might burn eggs or packs that you don't want to burn.  Have fun!
